verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing copy promises company-level visibility into progress toward top priorities as projects advance (jira-docs-14). It also mentions connecting initiatives across engineering, product, and marketing teams (jira-docs-8) and offers timeline views (jira-docs-11). That suggests cross-project rollup, but none of it describes an actual portfolio view, and there is no independent confirmation. Missing for 10: a documented cross-project portfolio or rollup view, detail on how progress is aggregated across projects, and hands-on or community confirmation.
